description: Create a mobile app (iOS/Android) for remote workout control, real-time metrics viewing, and ride history access. Connect to the desktop app over local network.

phases.name: Backend: Companion Server API
phases.description: Create a REST/WebSocket server in the Rust desktop app that the mobile companion can connect to over LAN

subtasks.title: Create companion module structure
subtasks.description: Set up src/companion/ module with mod.rs, server.rs, types.rs, and handlers.rs files. Add module to lib.rs exports.
acceptance_criteria: Basic types for companion API defined
subtasks.notes: Created companion module structure with mod.rs, types.rs, server.rs, and handlers.rs. Added module export to lib.rs. Commit fd8ff10.

subtasks.title: Define companion API types and messages
subtasks.description: Define CompanionRequest, CompanionResponse, and CompanionEvent types for WebSocket communication. Include authentication, metrics streaming, and control message types.
acceptance_criteria: CompanionRequest enum with all command variants
subtasks.notes: Types already implemented in T001. Verified: CompanionRequest with 12 command variants (Auth, GetSessionStatus, SubscribeMetrics, UnsubscribeMetrics, WorkoutPause, WorkoutResume, WorkoutSkip, WorkoutStop, AdjustResistance, GetRideHistory, GetRideDetails, Ping), CompanionResponse with 11 variants, CompanionEvent with 4 event types. All types have Serde serialization with #[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "snake_case")]. Supporting types include CompanionErrorCode, SessionState, SessionStatusInfo, RideSummary, RideDetailInfo, CompanionClient. Unit tests for serialization pass.

subtasks.title: Implement companion WebSocket server
subtasks.description: Create CompanionServer struct using tokio-tungstenite. Handle client connections, PIN authentication, and message routing. Bind to configurable port with LAN accessibility.
acceptance_criteria: Server binds to 0.0.0.0:port for LAN access
subtasks.notes: Implemented full WebSocket server with tokio-tungstenite. Features: LAN binding (0.0.0.0:port), concurrent client handling, PIN authentication, message routing to handlers, event broadcasting for metrics, local IP detection, graceful shutdown. Added rand and tokio net dependencies. Commit: a46ebce

subtasks.title: Implement mDNS service advertisement
subtasks.description: Use mdns-sd crate to advertise the companion server on LAN as '_rustride._tcp.local'. Include port and protocol version in TXT records for auto-discovery by mobile apps.
acceptance_criteria: TXT records include port and version
Service can be discovered from mobile device on same LAN
subtasks.notes: Implemented mDNS service advertisement using mdns-sd crate. Created CompanionMdnsAdvertiser in src/companion/discovery.rs. Service advertised as '_rustride._tcp.local.' with TXT records for port, version, and protocol. Integrated with CompanionServer start/stop lifecycle. Mobile apps can now auto-discover the companion server on LAN. Commit: a6b908e

subtasks.title: Implement metrics streaming handler
subtasks.description: Create handler that pushes real-time metrics (power, HR, cadence, speed) to connected mobile clients. Subscribe to sensor events and broadcast at 1Hz to authenticated clients.
acceptance_criteria: Includes power, HR, cadence, speed, distance
subtasks.notes: Implemented MetricsStreamer component in src/companion/streaming.rs. Features: 1) StreamingMetrics struct for aggregating power, HR, cadence, speed, distance, calories metrics. 2) MetricsStreamer that broadcasts at 1Hz via CompanionServer's event channel. 3) SensorEventProcessor adapter to process SensorEvent::Data from SensorManager. 4) create_metrics_streamer() method added to CompanionServer. 5) Comprehensive unit tests for metrics updates and streaming lifecycle. Only authenticated subscribed clients receive events (filtering handled by existing server code).

subtasks.title: Implement workout control handlers
subtasks.description: Create handlers for workout.pause, workout.resume, workout.skip, workout.stop commands from mobile clients. Integrate with existing daemon handler logic.
acceptance_criteria: Skip command advances to next interval
Proper error responses for invalid states
subtasks.notes: Implemented workout control handlers (pause, resume, skip, stop) with full DaemonState integration. Added CompanionServer.with_daemon_state() constructor and set_daemon_state() method for integration. Handlers validate session state and return proper error responses. Comprehensive unit tests added for all scenarios. Commit: 7a89c33

subtasks.title: Implement ride history API handlers
subtasks.description: Create handlers to list rides, get ride details, and get ride statistics. Query from SQLite database and return paginated results.
acceptance_criteria: Get single ride with full details
Include summary stats (avg power, duration, distance)
subtasks.notes: Implemented ride history API handlers. Updated handle_request() to accept database and user_id parameters. Implemented handle_get_ride_history() with pagination support (queries SQLite, returns paginated RideSummary list, includes workout name lookup). Implemented handle_get_ride_details() for full RideDetailInfo with all statistics (TSS, IF, NP, HR, cadence). Added ride_to_summary() and ride_to_detail() helper functions. Comprehensive unit tests for all ride history operations.

subtasks.title: Add companion server configuration
subtasks.description: Add CompanionConfig to storage/config.rs with enabled flag, port number, require_pin flag, and session timeout. Integrate with app settings UI.
acceptance_criteria: Config struct with all companion settings
subtasks.notes: Integrated CompanionConfig into AppConfig for persistence. Added CompanionConfig to storage/config.rs with #[serde(default)] for backward compatibility. Added re-export from storage::mod. Added example_companion_config() and load_companion_config() helper functions. Added 5 comprehensive tests for serialization, deserialization, defaults, and partial config handling. Commit: 3a97ae9

subtasks.title: Add connection QR code generation
subtasks.description: Generate QR code containing connection URL (ws://ip:port) and optional PIN for easy mobile app pairing. Use existing qrcode crate.
acceptance_criteria: QR code generated with connection URL
QR displayable in desktop app UI
subtasks.notes: Implemented QR code generation for companion app pairing. Created src/companion/qr.rs with: CompanionConnectionData (JSON-serializable connection info with url, optional pin, and version), CompanionQrCode (QR generator with ASCII and SVG output formats), generate_pairing_qr_code() convenience function, and QrCodeError for error handling. Added methods to CompanionServer: generate_qr_code(), get_qr_ascii(), get_qr_svg(), get_qr_svg_custom(). Uses existing qrcode crate with Medium error correction. Comprehensive unit tests included. Commit: 291771c

subtasks.title: Add session status endpoint
subtasks.description: Create handler returning current session state: active workout info, elapsed time, current interval, target power. Used by mobile app to sync UI state.
acceptance_criteria: Returns null if no active session
Includes workout name and file for workouts
subtasks.notes: Session status endpoint already fully implemented. handle_get_session_status() in handlers.rs (lines 103-173) returns current session state from DaemonState. Returns active: false when no session. For active sessions, returns SessionStatusInfo with: session_id, session_type (free_ride/workout), workout_name, workout_path, is_paused, elapsed_secs, current_interval_index, total_intervals, current_interval_name, target_power_watts, interval_remaining_secs. Unit tests included: test_get_session_status_with_active_workout and test_get_session_status_no_session. All acceptance criteria verified.

phases.name: Mobile App: Core Framework
phases.description: Set up React Native mobile app with navigation, state management, and core UI components

subtasks.title: Initialize React Native project
subtasks.description: Create React Native project in companion-app/ directory using react-native-cli. Configure TypeScript, ESLint, and Prettier. Set up Android and iOS build configurations.
subtasks.notes: Initialized React Native 0.83.1 project with TypeScript in companion-app/. Configured: ESLint with TypeScript and React plugins, Prettier for code formatting, path aliases for clean imports, Android SDK 36 with Hermes, iOS with LAN networking support. Created base type definitions and utility functions. All verification checks pass (lint, typecheck, format, tests). Commit: f03b60e

subtasks.title: Set up navigation structure
subtasks.description: Install React Navigation and configure bottom tab navigator with screens: Dashboard, Workout, History, Settings. Add stack navigators for detail screens.
subtasks.notes: Implemented React Navigation with bottom tab navigator (Dashboard, Workout, History, Settings tabs) and stack navigators for detail screens (RideDetail, Connection). Features: Tab icons using react-native-vector-icons/Ionicons, type-safe navigation with TypeScript, deep linking support for rustride:// URLs, smooth transitions. Created 6 screen components with placeholder UI. All verifications pass (lint, typecheck, tests). Commit: f7b4eb7

subtasks.title: Implement state management with Zustand
subtasks.description: Set up Zustand stores for connection state, metrics state, session state, and ride history. Define typed actions and selectors.
acceptance_criteria: Connection store with status, serverUrl, isAuthenticated
History store with ride list and cache
subtasks.notes: Implemented Zustand stores for mobile companion app state management. Created 4 stores: (1) connectionStore with WebSocket status, serverUrl, isAuthenticated, server discovery, reconnection tracking, and PIN management; (2) metricsStore with live metrics (power, HR, cadence, speed, distance, calories), 3-second power averaging, max HR tracking, target power/cadence, and power/HR zone utilities; (3) sessionStore with session lifecycle, workout/interval tracking, pause/resume state, and elapsed time; (4) historyStore with paginated ride list, date range and ride type filters, ride detail caching (LRU with 50 max entries). All stores have typed state, actions, and selector functions for optimized component subscriptions. Added RideDetailInfo type to types/index.ts. Commit: 1b23281

subtasks.title: Create WebSocket connection service
subtasks.description: Implement ConnectionService class that handles WebSocket connection, reconnection with exponential backoff, and message parsing. Integrate with Zustand stores.
subtasks.notes: Implemented ConnectionService class for WebSocket connection management. Features: (1) WebSocket connection to ws://host:port with lifecycle management, (2) Automatic reconnection with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, max 30s), (3) Message parsing for CompanionResponse and CompanionEvent types, (4) Integration with Zustand stores (connection, metrics, session, history), (5) Request/response correlation with timeouts, (6) Ping/pong keep-alive (30s interval), (7) Auth flow with PIN support, (8) Workout control methods (pause, resume, skip, stop), (9) Ride history fetching with pagination. Added WebSocket protocol types (CompanionRequest, CompanionResponse, CompanionEvent) to types/index.ts. Comprehensive unit tests (17 tests). Commit: a559280

subtasks.title: Implement mDNS discovery service
subtasks.description: Use react-native-zeroconf to discover RustRide servers on LAN. Parse TXT records for port and version. Provide list of available servers to connection UI.
subtasks.notes: Implemented DiscoveryService with react-native-zeroconf for mDNS discovery. Features: (1) Scans for _rustride._tcp.local. services, (2) Parses TXT records for port and version info, (3) Prefers IPv4 addresses with fallback to hostname, (4) Integration with connectionStore for discovered servers, (5) 30-second default scan timeout, (6) Event callbacks (onServerFound, onServerLost, onScanStarted, onScanStopped, onError), (7) Manual server addition support, (8) buildServerUrl() helper for WebSocket URLs. Added TypeScript type definitions for react-native-zeroconf, Jest mock for testing, and 21 comprehensive unit tests. Commit: 31cb93e

subtasks.title: Create design system and theme
subtasks.description: Define color palette, typography, spacing, and component styles matching desktop app. Create ThemeProvider with dark/light mode support.
subtasks.notes: Implemented complete design system and theme for React Native companion app matching desktop. Created: (1) colors.ts with dark/light palettes matching src/ui/theme.rs, power zone colors Z1-Z7, and HR zone colors; (2) typography.ts with font scale, text styles for metrics, buttons, labels; (3) spacing.ts with 4px base unit scale, border radius, shadows, component spacing; (4) theme.ts with Theme type and dark/light theme objects; (5) ThemeProvider.tsx with React Context, system theme detection, manual theme switching, useTheme/useColors/useSpacing hooks. Added @theme path alias to tsconfig.json, babel.config.js, jest.config.js. All 34 tests passing. Commit: d51e6f5

subtasks.title: Build reusable UI components
subtasks.description: Create MetricCard, Button, IconButton, ConnectionStatus, and LoadingSpinner components. Use React Native StyleSheet for styling.
subtasks.notes: Created 5 reusable UI components for the mobile companion app. Components: (1) MetricCard - displays workout metrics with value/unit/label, supports 3 sizes, zone colors, target/secondary values. (2) Button - customizable button with 5 variants (primary/secondary/outline/danger/ghost), 3 sizes, loading state, icon support. (3) IconButton - icon-only button with variants, circular option, loading state, proper accessibility. (4) ConnectionStatus - connection indicator with dot/badge/full variants, animated pulse for connecting state. (5) LoadingSpinner - animated spinner with message text, includes FullScreenLoader and InlineLoader variants. All components use theme system hooks, have TypeScript types, and are covered by 27 unit tests. Commit: ffe9923

phases.description: Implement server discovery, connection flow, and PIN authentication

subtasks.title: Create connection screen UI
subtasks.description: Build screen showing discovered servers, manual entry option, and connection status. Display server name, IP, and port in list.
subtasks.notes: Implemented full ConnectionScreen for server discovery and connection. Created ServerListItem component for displaying discovered servers (name, host:port, version badge). Created ManualEntryModal for manual IP:port entry with validation. Features: mDNS auto-discovery on mount, pull-to-refresh, connection status indicator, empty state UI. Added 19 unit tests for new components (117 total tests pass). Commit: c4fae89

subtasks.title: Implement QR code scanner
subtasks.description: Add QR code scanning using react-native-camera or vision-camera. Parse connection URL and PIN from QR data. Auto-connect after successful scan.
subtasks.notes: Implemented QR code scanning using react-native-camera-kit. Added QrConnectionData type with parsing functions, QRScannerModal component with camera permission handling, visual scan frame, and auto-connect. Updated ConnectionScreen to integrate QR scanning. Added 15 comprehensive tests.

subtasks.title: Build PIN entry dialog
subtasks.description: Create modal dialog for PIN entry when server requires authentication. 6-digit numeric input with keypad. Visual feedback on entry.
subtasks.notes: Implemented PinEntryModal component for server authentication. Features: 6-digit numeric PIN input with visual dot indicators, custom numeric keypad (0-9 with backspace), shake animation on wrong PIN with haptic feedback (Vibration API), auto-submit when 6 digits entered, loading state while authenticating, error message display, accessible with ARIA labels and live regions. Added 18 comprehensive unit tests covering all functionality. Commit: edc5122

subtasks.title: Implement authentication flow
subtasks.description: Send auth message with PIN over WebSocket. Handle auth_ok and auth_failed responses. Store authenticated state in Zustand.
subtasks.notes: Implemented authentication flow with PIN over WebSocket. Created useAuthentication hook that manages the auth flow lifecycle: detects when auth is required via ConnectionService callbacks, handles auth_ok/auth_failed responses, updates Zustand connectionStore. Integrated PinEntryModal into ConnectionScreen. Fixed ConnectionService to properly update store after auth responses. Added @hooks path alias and 27 comprehensive tests. Commit: af4c543

subtasks.title: Add connection persistence
subtasks.description: Store last connected server in AsyncStorage. Auto-reconnect on app launch if server is available. Remember PIN if user opts in.
subtasks.notes: Implemented persistent connection storage with AsyncStorage. Added StorageService for storing last server, PIN, and preferences. Created useAutoReconnect hook and AutoReconnectProvider for auto-reconnect on app launch. Updated connectionStore with currentServer tracking and storage integration. Updated ConnectionScreen to track current server when connecting.

Component shows power difference from target with coaching hints (increase/reduce power). Integrated into DashboardScreen. Added 15 unit tests. Commit: c95d66a

subtasks.title: Implement heart rate display

subtasks.title: Implement cadence display

Integrated into DashboardScreen replacing MetricCard. Added 18 comprehensive tests. Commit: abdd3af

subtasks.title: Implement secondary metrics
subtasks.description: Add smaller cards for speed (km/h or mph), distance, elapsed time, and calories. Unit preference from settings.

Updated DashboardScreen to use new secondary metrics with unit preferences loaded on mount. Added 54 unit tests for new stores and components. Commit: 294066d

subtasks.title: Add workout interval display

subtasks.notes: Implemented WorkoutIntervalDisplay component for showing workout interval progress. subtasks.title: Implement no-session state

subtasks.notes: Implemented NoSessionState component for Dashboard screen. (3) Connection status badge with server name when connected. (4) Helpful tips section explaining mobile app capabilities. (5) Full accessibility support with ARIA labels.
